comment: HS comparison: declared 300490 (medicaments, retail packs) and 390599 (other polymers of vinyl acetate/other, in primary forms). Both are only marginally supported. 300490 is WRONG as a primary code - the company does not sell finished medicaments; its pharmaceutical line is bulk API intermediates and fine chemicals (heterocyclic intermediates, alkylating/protecting agents, solvents), which fall in Chapters 29/38, not 3004. 390599 is PARTIAL - the Polymers & Resins segment does include specialty polymers, UV-curable resins and monomers, but the bulk of the catalogue (solvents, phenols, benzoic acids, nitriles, amines, azo initiators, biocides, surfactants, water-treatment chemicals) sits in Chapters 28-29, 34, 38 and 27 and is entirely missing from the declaration. Industry label 'Нефтегаз и химия' is only partly right: the site has an 'Energy' segment (fuel additives, corrosion/scale inhibitors, clay stabilizers, phase-change materials) but oil & gas is a minor slice of an 18-segment specialty-chemical distribution book; the dominant identity is general specialty chemicals / pharma intermediates distribution. Trader signs: no manufacturing, 'ready stock of 500+ products' in Bhiwandi warehouse, principals-based sourcing, testimonials from import-logistics and customs agents - classic importer-distributor. Per project rule 3 the HS mismatch is NOT a rejection ground: company stays in the base, declared codes should be corrected to the actual Chapter 28/29/38-led mix (with 3905/3906 retained for the polymer line and 3004 dropped or kept only as a residual). No customs line was verified here, so no product is confirmed as actually shipped - status for all lines: заявлено, не подтверждено. Revenue, export volume, CIN/PAN and registry data were deliberately not researched in this task (null).
